$comment: The narrative manifest. Beats are data, not code -- editing the story should not mean editing TypeScript. tools/validate.mjs cross-checks every gate and chapter named here against what the Blender build actually exported, so a typo fails the build instead of dead-ending a viewer mid-piece.
title: A Room That Remembers

lines.text: He fixed things. That was the whole of it.
Everything here came in broken and went out working.
Look at something long enough and it will tell you when.
This one took him four evenings.
A valve, a cracked solder joint, and a screw he had to make himself.
It belonged to a woman two streets over. She paid him in bread.
He kept it working for thirty years after she died.
